headline.zh: AI 开始同时进入科学计算、受控生命科学访问与文档工作流
headline.en: AI enters scientific computing, controlled life-science access and document workflows at once

summary.zh: 本窗口最可信的发布呈现同一条主线：要把模型带入高价值、高风险工作，能力提升必须与访问资格、身份治理、数据边界和人工复核一同设计。Anthropic 开源了生物分子模型优化代码并启动生命科学验证计划；OpenAI 则将 ChatGPT 嵌入 Word，并扩展了企业 API 的 SCIM 管理。
summary.en: The most credible releases in this window share one theme: taking models into high-value, high-risk work requires capability gains to be designed alongside eligibility, identity governance, data boundaries and human review. Anthropic open-sourced biomolecular-model optimizations and launched a life-science verification program; OpenAI embedded ChatGPT in Word and extended SCIM management to enterprise API access.

note.zh: 仅纳入带有明确日期的公开一手材料。模型加速、准确性与组织转型数字均按发布方陈述处理，不替代独立复现或评估。
note.en: Only public first-party material with a clear date is included. Claims on model acceleration, accuracy and organizational transformation are treated as publisher-reported, not substitutes for independent replication or evaluation.

signal.zh: 科学和企业应用的分水岭不再只是“模型能否完成任务”，而是能否在受限数据、身份与操作权限下可靠完成。代码优化、专业资格验证、SCIM 分组和文档内使用都把能力层与控制层耦合在一起。
signal.en: For science and enterprise use, the dividing line is no longer merely whether a model can complete a task, but whether it can do so reliably under constrained data, identity and operational permissions. Code optimization, professional verification, SCIM groups and in-document use all couple capability with controls.

watch.zh: 关注 Anthropic 的生物模型优化能否在独立硬件、任务和精度阈值下复现，并观察 LSVP 的资格核验与风险分级如何执行；企业方面应验证 Word 与 API SCIM 的管理员控制、数据流向和成本可见性。
watch.en: Watch whether Anthropic’s biomolecular optimizations reproduce across independent hardware, tasks and precision thresholds, and how LSVP executes eligibility checks and risk tiers. Enterprises should validate administrator controls, data flow and cost visibility for Word and API SCIM.

category.zh: AI for Science 与开源软件

title.zh: Anthropic 开源生物分子模型的推理优化代码
title.en: Anthropic open-sources inference optimizations for biomolecular models

what.zh: 【确认事实】Anthropic 于 9 月 17 日表示，在两名具备生物分子建模经验、但没有推理优化或内核工程经验的技术人员监督下，Claude 在不足四周内为 30 多个开源生物分子、蛋白质设计、基因组和蛋白语言模型完成优化。公司报告在精度轻微下降时平均约 4 倍加速、输出保持一致时近 2 倍加速，并开源优化代码；还称低内存模式可在单个 NVIDIA GPU 节点上处理超过 10,000 token 的生物分子系统。
what.en: [Confirmed fact] On September 17, Anthropic said that, supervised by two technical staff experienced in biomolecular modeling but not inference optimization or kernel engineering, Claude optimized more than 30 open-source biomolecular, protein-design, genomics and protein-language models in under four weeks. The company reports roughly 4x average acceleration with minimal precision loss and nearly 2x with identical outputs, and open-sourced the optimized code; it also says a low-memory mode handles biomolecular systems over 10,000 tokens on a single NVIDIA GPU node.

why.zh: 如果这些优化能复现，AI Agent 的价值将从生成候选结果扩展到改善科学软件本身的可达性与运行成本。需要注意的是，速度、精度与硬件内存之间的取舍高度依赖模型、数据集和评测协议。
why.en: If these optimizations reproduce, an AI agent’s value extends from generating candidate results to improving the accessibility and operating cost of scientific software itself. The tradeoff among speed, precision and hardware memory is highly dependent on model, dataset and evaluation protocol.

implication.zh: 【分析】研究团队应以锁定版本的代码、输入集和精度门槛复测速度与内存，并把数值等价、失败样本和生物学有效性分开记录；管理者应把开源许可、维护责任与实验验证预算纳入采用决策。
implication.en: [Analysis] Research teams should retest speed and memory against pinned code, input sets and accuracy thresholds, separately recording numerical equivalence, failure cases and biological validity. Leaders should include open-source licensing, maintenance ownership and wet-lab validation budget in adoption decisions.

sources.label: Anthropic · How Claude is uplifting biomolecular modeling

category.zh: 生命科学 AI 治理

title.zh: Anthropic 启动生命科学验证计划 LSVP 测试版
title.en: Anthropic launches the Life Sciences Verification Program beta

what.zh: 【确认事实】Anthropic 于 9 月 17 日推出 Life Sciences Verification Program（LSVP）测试版，面向团队和机构开放申请。该计划向经核验的生命科学专业人士提供 Mythos、Opus 和 Sonnet，并对通常在通用 Fable 模型中受限的药物发现、研究生物学、临床开发和制造任务采用更宽松的安全设置。Anthropic 称已通过早期计划接入数十家组织，并说明申请数据被严格隔离，不用于模型训练，也不对其生命科学研究团队开放。
what.en: [Confirmed fact] On September 17, Anthropic launched the beta Life Sciences Verification Program (LSVP) for team and institutional applications. It gives verified life-science professionals access to Mythos, Opus and Sonnet with safeguards more permissive for work that is normally restricted in the general-availability Fable models, including drug discovery, research biology, clinical development and manufacturing. Anthropic says dozens of organizations joined early access and that application data is compartmentalized from training and its life-science research teams.

why.zh: 这是把“更高能力”与专业资格验证绑定的产品治理模式。其成败不只取决于模型效果，也取决于资格审核、滥用监测、申诉流程和研究数据隔离是否经得起实际运营考验。
why.en: This is a product-governance model that binds higher capability to professional verification. Its success depends not only on model quality but on whether eligibility review, misuse monitoring, appeals and research-data isolation stand up in operation.

implication.zh: 【分析】申请或设计类似计划的机构应定义角色、机构关联、用途与再验证证据，设置最小权限、可审计日志和明确的人类复核升级路径；不要将获得访问资格等同于实验或临床批准。
implication.en: [Analysis] Organizations applying to or designing similar programs should define evidence for role, institutional affiliation, intended use and re-verification, with least privilege, auditable logs and clear human-review escalation. Access eligibility must not be equated with experimental or clinical approval.

category.zh: 生产力软件与企业部署

title.zh: OpenAI 将 ChatGPT 作为 Word 侧栏提供
title.en: OpenAI makes ChatGPT available as a Word sidebar

what.zh: 【确认事实】OpenAI 9 月 17 日发布说明称，ChatGPT for Word 可在 Microsoft Word 中通过侧栏起草、摘要、改写选中文本并调整标题与格式；它与 Excel、PowerPoint 共用同一 Microsoft 加载项。工作区管理员可在 ChatGPT 管理控制台启停该功能，Microsoft 365 管理员也必须允许该加载项；OpenAI 说明该功能将从 10 月 1 日起默认启用，并提示复杂格式、表格和图表仍可能需要人工处理。
what.en: [Confirmed fact] In September 17 documentation, OpenAI says ChatGPT for Word provides a Microsoft Word sidebar for drafting, summarizing, revising selected text and adjusting headings and formatting, using the same Microsoft add-in as Excel and PowerPoint. Workspace administrators can enable or disable it in the ChatGPT admin console, while Microsoft 365 administrators must also allow the add-in. OpenAI says it will be enabled by default from October 1 and notes that complex formatting, tables and charts may still need human handling.

why.zh: 把 AI 放进主文档编辑面会降低使用摩擦，却也使输出审查、文件敏感度、加载项权限和用量成本成为默认工作流的一部分。产品可用不代表内容已经过事实、法律或合规审阅。
why.en: Putting AI in the main document-editing surface lowers friction, but makes output review, file sensitivity, add-in permissions and usage cost part of the default workflow. Product availability does not mean content has passed factual, legal or compliance review.

implication.zh: 【分析】企业应在默认启用前分组试点，配置加载项许可与数据分类规则，并要求对事实、引文、条款和重大格式变更进行人工复核；同时监测共享额度和 token 计费。
implication.en: [Analysis] Enterprises should pilot by group before default enablement, configure add-in permissions and data-classification rules, and require human review of facts, citations, terms and material formatting changes while monitoring shared allowance and token billing.

category.zh: 企业身份与 API 治理

title.zh: OpenAI 将租户级 SCIM 扩展到 API Platform 访问管理
title.en: OpenAI extends tenant-wide SCIM to API Platform access management

what.zh: 【确认事实】OpenAI 的 9 月 17 日 Enterprise/Edu 发布说明显示，租户级 SCIM 已支持 API Platform：全局管理员可在管理控制台的 Product access 中，将同步组分配给 API 组织和选定项目。说明称成员无需接受邀请；由身份提供商管理的组成员变更会同步更新其管理的 API 成员资格。
what.en: [Confirmed fact] OpenAI’s September 17 Enterprise/Edu release notes state that tenant-wide SCIM now supports API Platform. Global administrators can assign synchronized groups to API organizations and selected projects through Product access in the Admin Console. Members do not need to accept an invitation, and group-membership changes managed in the identity provider update the API memberships that SCIM manages.

why.zh: API 使用的身份生命周期终于可以与企业目录、项目范围和离职回收流程对齐。它减少了手工邀请，却也要求管理员准确界定组到组织/项目的映射，避免把数据、预算或生产密钥的访问范围扩大。
why.en: API identity lifecycle can now align with enterprise directories, project scope and offboarding. It reduces manual invitations, but requires administrators to map groups to organizations and projects accurately so access to data, budgets or production keys is not broadened.

implication.zh: 【分析】安全与平台团队应为每个同步组维护最小权限矩阵，定期核对 SCIM 预期状态与实际 API 项目成员，并把服务账户、break-glass 访问和密钥轮换放在独立控制流程中。
implication.en: [Analysis] Security and platform teams should maintain a least-privilege matrix for each synchronized group, regularly reconcile intended SCIM state with actual API-project membership, and handle service accounts, break-glass access and key rotation through separate controls.

sources.label: OpenAI · Enterprise and Edu release notes

title.zh: OpenAI 说明 ChatGPT 灵活使用额度可覆盖多项 Agent 功能
title.en: OpenAI documents flexible usage credits across agentic features

summary.zh: 【确认事实】OpenAI 9 月 17 日更新的帮助文档称，符合资格的个人计划用户在包含额度用尽后，可用 usage credits 支付 Codex、ChatGPT Work、Word、Excel 与 PowerPoint 等功能，具体可用性因计划和账户而异。该机制说明这些工具可能共享用量约束；它不是对任何特定用户可购买、价格或额度的承诺。
summary.en: [Confirmed fact] In help documentation updated September 17, OpenAI says eligible personal-plan users can use usage credits after included allowance for features such as Codex, ChatGPT Work, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, with availability varying by plan and account. The mechanism indicates that these tools may share usage constraints; it is not a promise of purchase availability, price or quota for any particular user.

title.zh: OpenAI 提供 Enterprise 自定义 GPT 向插件迁移的时间表
title.en: OpenAI provides an Enterprise custom-GPT to plugin migration timeline

summary.zh: 【确认事实】OpenAI 的 9 月 17 日 Enterprise/Edu 发布说明称，受影响的 Enterprise 工作区已可开始自定义 GPT 向插件的迁移；计划于 9 月 25 日停止新建 GPT、12 月 11 日退休现有 GPT，并明确日期仍可能变动。迁移项目应先识别创建者和关键用户，测试迁移后的插件及其共享权限。
summary.en: [Confirmed fact] OpenAI’s September 17 Enterprise/Edu release notes say affected Enterprise workspaces can begin custom-GPT migration to plugins, with planned dates to end new GPT creation on September 25 and retire existing GPTs on December 11; the dates may change. Migration work should first identify creators and essential users, then test migrated plugins and their sharing permissions.

sources.label: OpenAI · Enterprise and Edu release notes

title.zh: Microsoft 分享其内部 AI 转型的管理经验
title.en: Microsoft shares internal AI-transformation management lessons

summary.zh: 【背景】Microsoft 9 月 17 日描述其“Customer Zero”内部转型，称管理者示范使用 AI 与员工心理安全和更高频 Agent 使用、信任相关。文中 17 个百分点、30 个百分点和 1.4 倍等数字来自 Microsoft 自身研究，适合作为组织试验假设而非普遍因果结论。
summary.en: [Context] On September 17, Microsoft described its internal ‘Customer Zero’ transformation and said manager modeling of AI use and psychological safety are associated with more frequent agent use and trust. The cited 17-point, 30-point and 1.4x figures are from Microsoft’s own research and are useful as organizational hypotheses, not universal causal conclusions.

sources.label: Microsoft · Lessons from its AI transformation

tryToday.zh: 为一个生物或科学模型建立可复现优化基线：锁定代码、硬件、输入集、精度阈值与内存，并把加速与科学有效性分开验收。
tryToday.en: Establish a reproducible optimization baseline for one biological or scientific model: pin code, hardware, input set, accuracy threshold and memory, and accept acceleration separately from scientific validity.

tryToday.zh: 审查高风险专业 AI 的访问路径：核验身份、最小权限、日志、用途限制和人工升级，明确访问许可不等于业务或临床批准。
tryToday.en: Review the access path for high-risk professional AI: verify identity, least privilege, logs, use restrictions and human escalation, and make clear that access permission is not business or clinical approval.

tryToday.zh: 在文档 AI 与 API 项目上进行一次身份和成本演练：测试 SCIM 加入/离开、管理员禁用、共享额度告警和敏感文档处理。
tryToday.en: Run one identity-and-cost drill across document AI and API projects: test SCIM joiner/leaver changes, administrator disablement, shared-allowance alerts and sensitive-document handling.
